cruise.event.boarding.name: Boarding
cruise.announce.boarding: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Boarding has begun. The launch runs from the pier head until six o'clock. The purser hands out cabin keys in the vestibule on the main deck.
cruise.event.departure.name: Departure
cruise.announce.departure: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Let go the anchor… I beg your pardon, weigh anchor! Three long blasts: we are under way. Those seeing us off are kindly asked to wave from the pier.
cruise.event.drill.name: Lifeboat drill
cruise.announce.drill: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Lifeboat drill. All passengers are to muster on the boat deck by boat number one. The bosun will show you the life jackets. There is no need to run.
cruise.event.dinner1.name: Dinner
cruise.announce.dinner1: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Dinner is served in the dining saloon on the main deck. Tonight: navy cutlets and stewed-fruit compote. Enjoy your meal.
cruise.event.isl_brothers.name: The Stone Brothers
cruise.announce.isl_brothers: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. On the starboard side: the Stone Brothers. Three stacks, the eldest forty metres tall. The sun sets right between them: photographers, look sharp.
cruise.event.concert1.name: Jazz evening
cruise.announce.concert1: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. In the music saloon Savely Blum's Noon Quartet is playing. Admission is free, dancing is allowed.
cruise.event.cards1.name: The card table
cruise.announce.cards1: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. A game of poker is being made up in the saloon. The stakes are small change and honour. The management takes no responsibility for losses.
cruise.event.lights_out.name: Lights out
cruise.announce.lights_out: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Twenty-three hundred hours. Lights out in the cabins. The radio room wishes you a good night; the watch stays awake.
cruise.event.isl_arch.name: The Needle's Eye
cruise.announce.isl_arch: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Good morning to those who are awake. On the port side: the Needle's Eye. From the foredeck you will see the sun rise right inside the arch.
cruise.event.wake.name: Reveille
cruise.announce.wake: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Good morning! It is seven o'clock. The weather is as ordered. The washbasins are free, morning exercise is in fifteen minutes.
cruise.event.exercise.name: Morning exercise
cruise.announce.exercise: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Morning exercise on the boat deck, led by our entertainer Rimma Volskaya. Feet shoulder-width apart!
cruise.event.breakfast2.name: Breakfast
cruise.announce.breakfast2: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Breakfast in the dining saloon: porridge, an egg, cocoa. Those who slept through the exercise still get their porridge.
cruise.event.isl_birds.name: Bird Island
cruise.announce.isl_birds: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. We are coming up to Bird Island. We shall go round it twice, dead slow. Please do not feed the birds cutlets. Binoculars are with the purser.
cruise.event.deckgames.name: Deck games
cruise.announce.deckgames: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. On the boat deck: the shuffleboard and ring-toss tournament. Sign up with Rimma Volskaya. The winner gets the captain's prize.
cruise.event.lunch2.name: Lunch
cruise.announce.lunch2: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Lunch. Aunt Pasha has made borscht, and that is not up for discussion. The dining saloon, main deck.
cruise.event.quiet.name: Quiet hour
cruise.announce.quiet: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Quiet hour. The deck chairs on the boat deck are free. The band is resting; the gulls are not.
cruise.event.bridge_tour.name: Tour of the bridge
cruise.announce.bridge_tour: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Those who wish are invited to the bridge. Captain Gromov will show the wheel, the telegraph and the chart. Do not turn the wheel until you are told you may.
dev.action.cruise.jump_bridge_tour: Cruise: jump to "Tour of the bridge"
cruise.event.tea2.name: Tea
cruise.announce.tea2: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Tea and sushki rings in the dining saloon. The samovar is a real one, have no doubt.
cruise.event.isl_lighthouse.name: The Far Light
cruise.announce.isl_lighthouse: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. We are anchoring off the Far Light, the last light before the open sea. The launch will take those who wish to the rock: we lie here two hours. The last launch back leaves at eighteen twenty. The keeper is glad of guests, though he will not show it.
cruise.event.captains_dinner.name: The captain's dinner
cruise.announce.captains_dinner: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. The captain's dinner. Captain Gromov invites everyone to table. Dress as you are, but do comb your hair.
cruise.event.concert2.name: Gala evening with dancing
cruise.announce.concert2: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Gala evening in the music saloon: the Noon Quartet, dancing until half past eleven. Ladies ask the gentlemen, and the other way round.
dev.action.cruise.jump_concert2: Cruise: jump to "Gala evening with dancing"
cruise.event.cards2.name: The card table
cruise.announce.cards2: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. The card table is open again. The engineer from Riga has promised everyone a chance to win it back.
cruise.event.anchor.name: Night anchorage at Long Island
cruise.announce.anchor: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. We are anchoring in the bay of Long Island. The engine is stopped. You can hear the sea breathe. Good night.
dev.action.cruise.jump_anchor: Cruise: jump to "Night anchorage at Long Island"
cruise.event.breakfast3.name: Breakfast
cruise.announce.breakfast3: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Breakfast: curd fritters with sour cream. Aunt Pasha asked us to say there are seconds for everyone.
cruise.event.quiz.name: Sea quiz
cruise.announce.quiz: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. In the music saloon: the sea quiz. How many knots are there in a mile? None: that one is a trap. Rimma has the other questions.
cruise.event.isl_seals.name: The Seal Rocks
cruise.announce.isl_seals: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. To port: the Seal Rocks. We are going quietly. The seals are at home today; please do not whistle, they take offence.
cruise.event.lunch3.name: Lunch
cruise.announce.lunch3: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. The last lunch of the voyage: fish soup and navy-style macaroni. The dining saloon, main deck.
cruise.event.diplomas.name: Diplomas
cruise.announce.diplomas: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. In the music saloon the captain is presenting seafarer's diplomas to all who have made it to the end of the voyage. Nobody has failed to.
cruise.event.home_in_sight.name: Lyudmilovsk in sight
cruise.announce.home_in_sight: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. Lyudmilovsk has come into sight dead ahead. Whoever spots the lighthouse on the pier first gets a compote.
cruise.event.arrival.name: Arrival
cruise.announce.arrival: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. We are on the Lyudmilovsk roads. The anchor is down. The crew thanks you for the voyage.
cruise.event.landing.name: Landing
cruise.announce.landing: Attention, please. This is the motor ship Polden's radio room. The launch is at the gangway. Landing goes on until eight in the evening. Please hand your cabin keys to the purser. Until next Friday!

cruise.say.board.hold: Welcome aboard! Cabin fifteen, lower deck: down the stairs and to the right. Here is your key, do not drop it in the sea. Dinner is at half past seven.
cruise.say.board.std: Welcome aboard! Cabin seven, here on the main deck: along the corridor toward the bow, starboard side. Here is your key. Dinner is at half past seven.
cruise.say.board.lux: Welcome aboard! You have a de luxe cabin, number eleven: the promenade deck, aft. Here is your key. The captain sends his compliments. Dinner is at half past seven.
cruise.say.board.late: Ah, there you are! Cabin number {0}, here is the key. The programme is on the board in the vestibule.
cruise.say.ashore: Here we are! Last launch, all ashore. The cabin key goes to me. Come again on Friday, we will find you a berth.
cruise.say.ashore_over: Ahoy there aboard! The voyage ended long ago and he is still asleep. Ashore with you, ashore! The launch will not wait.
cruise.say.ashore_early: Going ashore? Well, it is your own business. The ticket is spent, the key goes to me. Fair winds!
cruise.say.overboard: Man overboard! Stop engine! …Threw the ring, hauled him out. Alive? Off you go and dry out. And no more leaning over the rails!
cruise.say.stowaway: And how did you get here? Nobody is allowed aboard without a ticket. Oh well, have a look round, and then ashore with you.
cruise.say.ashore_warn.1: Ahoy on the rock! Eighteen hundred. The launch leaves in twenty minutes. Make your way to the jetty, no hurry.
cruise.say.ashore_warn.2: Ahoy on the rock! Ten minutes to the last launch. Whoever is up on the lighthouse gallery, come down, and never mind counting the steps.
cruise.say.ashore_warn.3: Last launch! Three minutes. Anyone I find missing I shall come and fetch myself, and that is worse.
cruise.say.ashore_fetch: So there you are! The ship is not paid to wait. Into the launch with you, and let me not go hunting for you on the rocks again. Did you give the keeper my regards?
cruise.say.ashore_swim: Where to?! The water is eight degrees and the ship is three hundred metres off. Out you come onto the jetty, swimmer. The launch will take you.
